QuestInfo.name: Pantheon and the Other Dimension
QuestInfo.0: Pantheon is the stepping stone to another dimension. Go there.
QuestInfo.1: You arrived in Pantheon, presenting yourself as an adventurer, and gained information on the Interdimensional Portal.
